title: ChatV2StreamingAdapter 的 content / thinking / web_search 块事件统一携带 roundId 与 skillStateVersion 元数据

rust.behavior: tool_loop.rs:660 创建 ChatV2LLMAdapter 时传入 skill_state_version 与 Some(format!("tool-round-{recursion_depth}"))，但 llm_adapter.rs 只在 on_tool_call_start (line 1390/1397) 调用 register_block_event_meta / emit_tool_call_preparing_with_meta 携带 round_id 与 skill_state_version；ensure_content_started / ensure_thinking_started / emit_chunk / emit_end / emit_error (lines 394, 415, 432, 572, 1176, 1206, 1231) 漏传 round_id 与 skill_state_version，导致 content/thinking 块事件缺少所属工具轮次标识

fix.behavior: ChatV2StreamingAdapter.eventMeta() 将 { skillStateVersion, roundId } 统一传给 emitStart / emitChunk / emitEnd / emitError / emitToolCallPreparingStart，使同一工具轮次内的 content、thinking、web_search 与 tool_call_preparing 事件一致带有 roundId（及非 null 时的 skillStateVersion）

evidence: tool_loop.rs:660 在每轮（含第 0 轮文本回合）构造 ChatV2LLMAdapter 时显式传入 round_id = Some("tool-round-0") 和 skill_state_version，并在紧邻的 skill_injection_audit 事件（tool_loop.rs:582）发出 roundId: "tool-round-0"；llm_adapter.rs 保存了这两个字段却只在 tool_call_preparing 事件上传给 emitter，属于遗漏。host/e2e/streaming/normal-answer.test.ts:102、cancel-after-partial.test.ts:130、error-after-partial.test.ts:134、thinking.test.ts:126 均验证 content/thinking 事件携带 roundId: 'tool-round-0'

tests.name: RF-W05-streaming-adapter-block-round-id: content and thinking block events carry roundId and skillStateVersion metadata
